content:
<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of nitride compositions (up to 40) with energy above hull ≤ 0.3 eV/atom and at most 3 polymorphs per composition. After retrieval we will consolidate the individual JSON files into a single dataset and return the path to that consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiN", "VN", "ZrN", "HfN", "NbN", "MoN", "CrN",
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "Si3N4", "BN", "ScN",
        "YN", "LaN", "CeN", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN", "CuN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "nitride_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
